name: A Matter of Time
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Tampering of the timeline by a sinister force - most likely the Scourge - has occurred in Andorhal!  I can try to keep the passage of time here intact and mend what has been damaged, but I'll need your help to do so uninterrupted.

Temporal parasites - carrion that feed on the strands of time's altered flow - now infest the silos of Andorhal.  A blue pulse of distortion is their only visual marker.  They slow my auguries; please adventurer, help me by using this temporal displacer to root out these parasites.
narrative.objectives:
Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.

Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Time feels easier to mend now, thank you adventurer. While you might not understand fully the consequences of a fractured timeline, I appreciate that you understand the urgency of countering what I suspect more and more to be a Scourge-driven malfeasance.

I see no harm in rewarding you for your assistance, mortal. Your greatest feats are to come, and the awarding of a bauble will certainly not alter your future destiny. Your continued aid, however, is something that I and the dragonflight could use...
narrative.requestItemsText:
Temporal parasites are a common malady present wherever the flow of time has been tampered with.  I sense that many are present, and this is disturbing.

Rooting out whatever ones you can find will help me be able to take a better hold on the deteriorating temporal situation here.  I will be able to sense when this has been achieved.
